newsitem.title: USA: Bio Plexus to get NASDQ Small Cap listing.
newsitem.headline: Bio Plexus to get NASDQ Small Cap listing.

text.p: Bio Plexus Inc said Tuesday that its stock listing will be moved to the NASDAQ SmallCap Market, from the NASDAQ National Market, effective February 20.

The company said NASDAQ determined that Bio-Plexus's efforts to conform to the $4 million minimum net tangible asset requirements for continued listing on the NASDAQ National Market may not yield suitable results within an acceptable time frame.

According to the company, NASDAQ also said Bio Plexus is currently complying with initial inclusion requirements for the NASDAQ SmallCap Market, and will likely remain in compliance with the lower requirements of that market over the long term.
Bio Plexus is a designer, developer, manufacturer and marketer of safety medical products.
